Text.Text: Cheat Keybind
Coins: +100,000 / −100,000 Normal: add; alternative: subtract. Negative amounts still need an in-game check; bankruptcy is possible.
All goods: +1,000 / −1,000 Normal: add; alternative: subtract. Unlocked goods on your current or selected owned island. Negative amounts still need an in-game check.
Increase / decrease workforce Normal: increase; alternative: decrease. Current owned island only. The native cheat determines the amount; does not add residents.
Build without material checks: On/Off Bypass material requirements. Costs can still be deducted; bankruptcy is possible.
Upgrade without requirements: On/Off Allow building upgrades despite unmet requirements.
Factory fertility: On/Off Toggle the required fertility for your selected owned factory.
Complete ship or unit instantly Finish current recruitment in your selected owned shipyard or recruitment building.
Advance monument construction Affects your selected owned monument. Advances only part of the phase; repeat as needed.
Complete / cancel current research Normal: complete the first queued technology; alternative: cancel it. No refund behavior is established.
Research all / reset all research Normal: research every technology; alternative: reset all. Normal execution no longer toggles research back off.
Add random items On your current owned island.
Take over foreign object or island Kontor/Villa: the whole island; otherwise the selected foreign object. May desync multiplayer.
Cheats: previous selection (without executing)
Cheats: next selection (without executing)
Cheats: execute selected cheat
Requirement missing The selected cheat lacks a suitable game context.
Cheat failed – see log CheatKeybinds_Serp records the cheat, execution direction and error.
Cheats: delete selection (without ruins)
Cheats: destroy selection
Reload mods
Open/close Lua console
Emperor reputation: +10 / −10 Normal: +10; alternative: −10 with the current emperor. Normal reputation scale: −100 to +100.
Reset diplomacy cooldowns Reset your own action cooldowns. Other restrictions, such as pending replies or unmet requirements, remain.
Cheats: alternative execution
Goods: choose your own island Move the view to an owned island or select a building there.
Workforce: choose your own island Move the view to an owned island. A building selection alone is not enough here.
Items: choose your own island Move the view to an owned island.
No object selected Select an object appropriate for this cheat.
Fertility: select a factory The selection has no suitable factory property.
Recruitment: select your own shipyard Select an owned shipyard or recruitment building with production in progress.
Monument: select your own monument The selection is not a suitable monument.
Foreign object selected This cheat requires an object you own.
Research queue is empty Start research before completing or cancelling it.
Takeover: select a foreign object You already own the selected object.
No current player available This cheat requires a valid current participant.
No active emperor available This cheat requires a valid active emperor.
Diplomacy currently unavailable The current player has no valid diplomacy property.
Workforce currently unavailable The current island workforce manager is invalid.
